intended_object: η, the order type of the rationals with their usual order (equivalently, by Cantor's theorem, of any countable dense linear order without endpoints). Taken from the docstring and the scoped notation "η".
explanation: The definition is `type ℚ`: the order type (the isomorphism class of linear orders) of ℚ with its standard linear order. That is exactly the classical η. It names one specific order type, so the question of generality does not arise. I found no other Mathlib definition of this order type; the only nearby definition is `theta`, the order type of ℝ.
